notes: Ludum Dare 41 entry Hypätä Kortti (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/41/$84836), a card-and-platformer climber. Complete Unity 2017.3.0f3 project (Assets+ProjectSettings+UnityPackageManager) with playable mainScene, gameplay scripts (deck, hand, cards, player, platforms), author-made Pyxel Edit art, and audio made in Bosca Ceoil plus voice recorder. MIT. Includes Pixelplacement iTween 2.0.7 (MIT, Bob Berkebile) with Robert Penner easing equations (BSD). No bundled fonts, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no LFS, no DLL/EXE. ~18M src snapshot.
